deadline.value: Fall applications due February 1; Spring applications due September 1.

gre_general.value: GRE not required for admission; a quantitative score above the median is strongly recommended for assistantship priority.
gre_general.quote: GRE score is not required for admission.

toefl_min.value: Department minimum TOEFL iBT 81 (4.5 on the new scale).

supervisor.value: Admitted without a named supervisor; the research advisor is chosen in the second semester.
supervisor.quote: Research advisor should be selected by the second semester at NDSU.

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's-to-PhD (90 credits) and master's-to-PhD (60 credits) routes both exist; a previous computer science degree is required.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s to Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science degree requirements

also.quote: Applicants with a bachelor's degree only should meet a minimum GPA of 3.25 in previous coursework.

notes: Software and Security Engineering also offers a PhD in the same catalog (not saved).
